|quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Behead Support''' is a [[support gem]] for [[strike]] skills that grants added strike range, more damage against enemies on [[low life]], and kills made with the supported skill against {{c|rare|Rare}} monsters steal one of its [[monster modifier]]s for a duration. ==Mechanics== Unlike {{il|Headhunter}} and {{il|Inspired Learning}}, Behead is limited to 1 stolen monster modifier, even when killing multiple rare enemies. Gaining a new monster modifier replaces the existing one. When supporting a compatible [[minion]] skill such as {{il|Dominating Blow}}, minions are capable of stealing one modifier each. Behead's {{c|mod|with Melee Weapons}} condition does not necessarily prevent its use with visually [[unarmed]] minions like {{il|Raise Zombie}}, as minions can mechanically wield weapons regardless of visual appearance.Viperesque https://imgur.com/a/6wuYOlG from https://discord.com/channels/174993814845521922/174994219390337024/931616087949324339 ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Melee
